user.title: Set up Gut Check
user.description: Paste the API key from your TypeSafe account. One small test question is sent to check it before anything else happens.

reauth_confirm.title: Update your API key
reauth_confirm.description: The saved API key stopped working. Paste a new one to keep Gut Check running.

error.invalid_auth: That API key was rejected. Check it and try again.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the API to check the key. Try again in a moment.
error.rate_limited: The API is busy right now, so the key could not be checked. Try again in a minute.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Gut Check is already set up. Only one instance is allowed.

data.health_enabled: Run the weekly home health check
data.device_class_enabled: Run the weekly device class suggestions
data.undo_device_class: Change back a device class Gut Check set

data_description.updates_enabled: Scores pending updates as routine, feature, or possibly breaking. Advisory only, never installs anything.
data_description.areas_enabled: Suggests an existing area for each device that has none. Nothing is assigned until you confirm a suggestion in Repairs.
data_description.device_class_enabled: Suggests a device class for sensors that report a unit but have none. Nothing is set until you confirm a suggestion in Repairs.
data_description.daily_budget: A hard stop for the day. It resets at local midnight.
data_description.critical_label: Entities or devices with this label are never sent or checked. Locks, alarms and covers are never checked either, label or not.
data_description.undo_device_class: Opens a list of the sensors whose device class you set from a Gut Check suggestion, so you can change any of them back.

undo_device_class.title: Change back device classes
undo_device_class.description: Pick the sensors to change back. Gut Check clears the device class it set, leaves any that were changed since, and stops suggesting a device class for them.

unavailable_entity.title: {entity_id} needs attention
unavailable_entity.description: `{entity_id}` has been unavailable for {unavailable_for}. Gut Check thinks it is worth fixing. Nothing will be changed automatically, and ignoring this card keeps it hidden on later checks.

possibly_breaking_update.title: {entity_id} update may need attention
possibly_breaking_update.description: `{entity_id}` is offering version {latest_version}. Gut Check read the release notes and thinks this update could change or break something. Nothing is installed automatically, and ignoring this card keeps it hidden on later checks.

init.title: Suggested area
init.description: Gut Check suggests **{area_name}** for {device_name}. Nothing changes unless you assign it.

menu_options.ignore: Don't suggest an area for this device

abort.suggestion_outdated: The device or the area changed since this suggestion was made, so nothing was changed and the card was removed.
abort.suggestion_ignored: Gut Check will stop suggesting an area for this device. The card is now in your ignored repairs.

init.title: Suggested device class
init.description: Gut Check suggests **{class_name}** for `{entity_id}`, which reports in {unit}. Nothing changes until you choose. You can change it back later from Gut Check's Configure screen.

menu_options.ignore: Don't suggest a device class for this sensor

choose.title: Choose a device class
choose.description: Pick the device class for `{entity_id}`. Only classes that accept {unit} are listed. You can change it back later from Gut Check's Configure screen.

abort.suggestion_outdated: The sensor changed since this suggestion was made, so nothing was changed and the card was removed.
abort.suggestion_ignored: Gut Check will stop suggesting a device class for this sensor. The card is now in your ignored repairs.

run_in_progress.message: This recipe is already running. Try again when it finishes.
